# <span id="aanchor83"></span> Access Lists

Use the Access List Editor to give users access to specific meters, quality sources, and locations. First, create an access list that contains meters, quality sources, and locations, and then assign the users and groups that should have access to those items. You can assign users and user groups to multiple access lists.

You can grant users and user groups access to all meters, quality sources, and locations in User Access (**Settings** \> **Settings Manager** \> **Users**) and Group Access (**Settings** \> **Settings Manager** \> **Groups**).

<div class="procedure">

To create an Access List:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.

2.  In the **Security** group, select **Access Lists**.
    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 600;height: 500;" />  

3.  On the **Access Lists** tab, click **New**.

4.  Provide a name for the access list and select the type of devices that you want to add to the list.

5.  From the list of available members, select the members that you want to add and use the right arrow button to add them to the list. You can also click **Query** to populate the list using a query.

    Access lists are not dynamic, even if you use a query to populate the members. If you need to update a list, you must manually update it.

To view the assigned access lists for a meter or quality source:

1.  In the Access List Editor, click **New**.

2.  Click **Lookup**.

3.  Select whether to view meters or quality sources.

4.  Select a list member to view the access lists for that member.

    Lookup is not available for locations.

To add users and groups to an Access List:

1.  On the **Access Lists** tab, select the access list that you want to modify and click **Edit**.
2.  On the **Group and User Access** tab, select the available groups or users that you want to add to the access list and use the right arrow button to add them to the list. You can also click **Query** to populate the list using a query.

</div>
